stories.title: AUSL Championship — Utah Talons Win Game 2, Back-to-Back Champions
stories.angle: The Utah Talons defeated the Chicago Bandits in Game 2 of the AUSL Championship Series on Sunday at Davis Diamond, completing a sweep and becoming the first team in AUSL history to win back-to-back championships. Montana Fouts started Game 2 for Utah — her first start of the series after Georgina Corrick pitched the complete-game 2-1 Game 1 victory on Saturday. The Talons, who swept the Bandits in the 2025 inaugural championship as well, are now the standard against which every future AUSL franchise will be measured. They won back-to-back championships across the AUSL's first two seasons.

x_posts.text:

stories.title: Georgina Corrick — The Game 1 Gem That Started a Dynasty
stories.angle: Before the Talons could celebrate back-to-back championships on Sunday, they needed someone to win Game 1 on Saturday. That was Georgina Corrick, not Montana Fouts. Corrick threw a complete game in the 2-1 Utah victory — allowing just 4 hits, 1 earned run, recording 5 strikeouts, and walking no one. She retired 15 of the final 16 batters she faced. Sahvanna Jaquish delivered the go-ahead sacrifice fly in the bottom of the 6th. It was Lexi Kilfoyl — the Bandits' ace who went 6-0 this regular season — who started and took the loss. Corrick's Game 1 performance saved the Talons' bullpen for Game 2 and gave Utah all the momentum it needed heading into Sunday.

stories.title: Montana Fouts — 2026 AUSL Pitcher of the Year and the Record Books
stories.angle: Montana Fouts was named the 2026 AUSL Pitcher of the Year. She earned it by setting four AUSL single-season records: innings pitched (61.1), strikeouts (63), wins (7), and complete games (7). Her ERA was 2.36. She also holds the single-game strikeout record at 12. Fouts started Game 2 of the AUSL Championship Series on Sunday, adding a championship appearance to an historic regular season. She is the most decorated pitcher in AUSL history after two seasons.

stories.title: Transfer Portal — Alabama Softball Adds Three Marquee Pieces
stories.angle: Alabama softball's transfer portal class is turning heads. The Crimson Tide added Jaysoni Beachum (3B, from Florida State — 2026 First Team All-ACC, .406 BA, 10 HR, 69 RBI), Tori Edwards (1B/UTIL, from LSU — 12 HR, 45 RBI, 1.019 OPS), and Karlee Ford (C, from Iowa State — Second Team All-Big 12, .345 BA, 14 2B, 10 HR, 49 RBI). Three proven power producers from three different conferences. September 1 — when D1 coaches can contact Class of 2028 recruits — is 36 days away. The arms race in college softball's transfer portal is reshaping rosters in real time.

stories.title: PGF Nationals Week 2 Begins — 14U, 12U, and 10U Championships
stories.angle: PGF Nationals Week 2 begins today in Southern California with 14U, 12U, and 10U divisions. Week 1 finished Saturday with two national champions crowned: Athletics Mercado won the 16U Premier title on a walk-off hit by Teuila Jaelynn Eteaki, defeating Hotshots National-Galloway 3-2; AZ Rising won the 18U Premier championship via run rule over Lady Dukes Lamar. PGF Nationals continues through August 2. September 1 — the Class of 2028 first-contact date — is 36 days away.
